method: Same browser/device, same six representative board cases and identical gallery harness. Each board warmed, then 12 consecutive redraw calls measured. Two steady-state passes per button activation; three activations per viewport. Committed JavaScript dependency graphs served directly from Git to avoid stale service workers. Grayscale and collision overlays disabled. No gameplay RNG changes.
limits: Synchronous CPU redraw timing only; not GPU frame rate, battery usage, or physical-phone measurements. A displayed0.00ms is below this timer/rounding resolution, not zero work. Both baseline passes, including its recurring p95 spikes, are retained; no favourable run selection. The harness substitutes cache statistics with a neutral stub because main lacks the new stats export; memory evidence comes from the separate real-cache tests.
